name: riposte-adapters
description: Hold adapters: the delivery surface for Riposte's gate and autonomy rungs. A Claude Code PreToolUse hook mode (off by default), a LangGraph AgentMiddleware.wrap_tool_call and an OpenAI Agents tool_input_guardrail. Record and advise surface; gate and autonomy hold a FAIL or ABSTAIN until a person resolves it. Also: Riposte verdicts as Langfuse, Braintrust and UK AISI Inspect scores, and as SARIF 2.1.0 for GitHub code scanning.
author: E. Tucker Anderson
